LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsShowShipPlannerTip: Show ship layout control and zone markers in the Prefab markers tab while God mode is active.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanUndoDesc: Clear buildings and items within the original shell and restore its foundation, roofs and zone markers. Move occupants off the ship first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanExportDesc: Export the current layout, including crew and SpaceObject markers, as a prefab.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanCancelDesc: Stop the current search and keep the original shell.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanStartDesc: Plan corridors first, then fit rooms, life support and propulsion. The preview may trim unused foundation at the outer edge.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanRemoveDesc: Remove this idle layout control marker.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanWidthDesc: Choose widths by section automatically, or set the whole corridor network to one, two or three cells.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanTaskDesc: Choose which ship functions the planner should prioritize.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanShell: Use an empty connected ship foundation, at most 1,600 cells and 100 cells along either axis.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanEmpty: The shell must contain only one layout control and the authoring markers. Remove other things and pawns first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanChanged: The shell or its markers changed during the search. Nothing was placed.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanBadResult: The preview does not fit this shell or would replace a retained marker. Nothing was placed.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanReady: Ship preview installed. You can export it or restore the shell.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanUndoBlocked: Restore from the original shell. Remove any occupants (including those in containers), buildings crossing its edge or incompatible foundations before restoring.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanConfigure: Set up the local ship planner first: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanGodOnly: Enable God mode to place prefab markers.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanPacking: The search could not fit every required room and its entrance. Leave wide sections for the bridge and fuel room, or move room markers. The shell is unchanged. Report: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanLayout: The rooms fit, but none of the layouts passed access, airtightness or life support checks. The shell is unchanged. Report: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanPropulsion: No layout passed the propulsion, exhaust clearance and fuel checks. The shell is unchanged. Report: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanBudget: The search reached its limit without a verified preview. The shell is unchanged. Report: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanWorkerFailure: The ship planner did not finish successfully. The shell is unchanged. Report: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanOrbit: Place this marker on ship foundation on an orbital map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShipPlanCrewKindDesc: Select the pawn kind spawned when the exported prefab is imported.
